When the child Arthur's father is murdered, Vortigern (Jude Law), Arthur's uncle, seizes the crown. programme.title: DORA S4 Ep.402: Snake Bike
programme.desc: On her way to the new bike park, Dora teaches Selena the Snake how to ride a bicycle.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.105: Princess and the Pirate Puppy / Caracol Cove
programme.desc: Santi and crew will have to team up with a pirate puppy to stop Bonnie Bones and save an old friend. // Enrique's new gold-digging machine threatens Lorelai's home.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.120: Relay Tales / The Barbababies' World
programme.desc: Barbalib, Barbalala and Barbabelle take turns as narrators to tell a story, each one bringing a very personal touch to it. // The Barbapapa family spends a day at the beach. Divided into 2 teams, the barbababies fight over a sandy peninsula.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.103: Born To Be Wild
programme.desc: Boris the elephant misses home. The Barbapapa decide to bring him back to Africa. On the spot, they help Boris to acclimatize.

programme.title: Bedtime Stories with Ryan S1 Ep.101: Goodnight &, Hello, Poo
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan tells stories that are a gas.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S6 Ep.614: Pups Save a Bat Family / Pups Save a Mud Monster
programme.desc: A rockslide traps a Bat Family inside their cave, so the Pups have to free them! The bats search for a new home leads to problems in town though! // Snowboarders on Jake's Mountain are stuck on a broken chair lift while a monster is on the loose!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S8 Ep.810: Pups and Katie Stop the Barking Kitty Crew!
programme.desc: When Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his "barking" kitties, Katie and the pups must rescue the town.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.307: The Crew Builds A Firefighter Training Center / The Crew Builds A Sierra Sparkle Space Show
programme.desc: When Motor needs help at the fire station, a new Fire Captain comes to town to help train all the pups as new firefighter recruits. // Charger can't wait to help Sierra Sparkle with her big show! Well, until his hurt paw causes a cone complication.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.308: The Crew Builds A Giant Duck Plane / The Crew Builds A Vet Room For Motor
programme.desc: A flock of migrating ducks settles in Builder Cove! It's up to Rubble & Crew to help the ducks start moving south. // Motor doesn't want to visit Dr. Diwa at the Vet Clinic... so the pups build a special space just for her!

programme.title: DORA S1 Ep.105: Friendaversary Adventure / Swiper's Birthday Surprise
programme.desc: Boots and Dora journey to Banana Hill to bring Isa a Friendiversary gift - a flowerpot that Boots painted himself! // Dora and friends throw Swiper a surprise birthday party. On the way to the party, Swiper attempts to swipe his own surprise present.

programme.title: DORA S1 Ep.106: The Little Axolotl / Bubble Trouble
programme.desc: Dora and Boots find an adorable baby axolotl. They have to bring him home, but he keeps wandering off. // The Big Red Chicken gets stuck in a giant floating bubble and is heading straight for a volcano! Dora has to do a mid-air rescue to save him.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.108: The Competition Prize / Marvelous Moustaches
programme.desc: The Barbabies win a touchpad. They all want to use it and snaffle it one after another. // Barbazoo collects photos of moustached celebrities. Unfortunately, it's impossible to find the last one: Charles Horseshoe-Furlip. He suspects a conspiracy...

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.109: Let Justice Be done / The Great Spring Clean
programme.desc: Barbabeau forgot to return his book to the library. As Mr Strict the librarian is visiting Barbapapa today, Barbabeau decides to run away. // Barbamama wants the barbababies to tidy their bedrooms. They're hiding to escape the drudgery.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.110: Double Dare You / Roy
programme.desc: On a ski trip, the Barbapapas build a giant igloo. Barbabravo and Barbalib challenge each other to find out who is braver. // Barbabright creates a vacuuming robot that's also very good at soccer. The Barbababies organise a match against the robots.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.111: The Grass is Always Greener... / When I Grow Up
programme.desc: Barbabright coats the house in magic product to prevent water leakage. The next day, The house deflates like a balloon. // A bird builds its nest on Barbazoo's belly. Barbazoo wants to become a big tree to shelter animals. This becomes complicated.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.112: The Cave Barbapapas / The Little Monsters
programme.desc: The barbababies discover a strange cave. Barbalib tells the story of the caves Barbapapa and how they transformed. // The Barbababies have a sleepover in the living room. Fearing the monsters in the closet, they set up wacky traps to catch them.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.408: The Crew Builds A Soap Box Derby / The Crew Builds A Bird Flight School
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew help Auntie Crane when Speed Meister challenges her to see who's the fastest soap box car racer in Builder Cove. // When Wingsy the eagle is having takeoff trouble, Rubble & Crew work with Dr. Diwa to help teach her how to fly again.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.409: The Crew Builds A Pancake Café / The Crew Builds An Airplane Wash
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew wants to make the biggest pancake ever! But it's a sticky situation when Speed Meister wants to beat them to it. // When Camila's plane gets dirty from leading migrating ducks home, the pups find a way to wash the plane... in the sky!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.309: Pups Save a Dragon / Pups Save Three Little Pigs
programme.desc: A fantasy fire breathing dragon comes to life and won’t let Ryder and pups into the Lookout! Paw Patrol takes to the Air Patroller! // The Paw Patrol help three little pigs build new houses after theirs mysteriously disappear.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.310: Pups Save a Stinky Flower / Pups Save a Monkey-Naut
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger drops off a ‘gift’ to Mayor Goodway, a flower that spreads a horrible stink when it blooms. // Mayor Goodway tries to return it to him, but runs into trouble and has to be rescued by the Paw Patrol.

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.415: Dino-Kai / The Space Ace
programme.desc: Kai feels unappreciated by the rest of the Squad, so teams up with Baron Bite believing he's good. // Bobbi admires Kenny's coolness and imitates him, but the rest of the squad miss his playful side.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1 Ep.101: The Royal Fairy Picnic / Gaston the Ladybird
programme.desc: Holly invites Ben on the annual Royal Fairy Picnic. King Thistle hopes there won't be a repeat of last year's jelly flood. // Holly and Ben try to cheer up Gaston by tidying his cave. But Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.105: Moon Cow / Nebulator / Space Bug
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy & Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner. // Kai is super excited to ride the Nebulator, but Tim isn't so sure. // Tim and Kai try to photograph the illusive SpaceBug.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.306: The Crew Builds A Giant Turtle House / The Crew Builds A Giant Volcano
programme.desc: It's Friend Appreciation Day! But when Speed Meister's gift for Mr. McTurtle goes awry, he has to call Rubble & Crew for help. / Rubble & Crew help Lucas make the most awesome Science Fair volcano ever. But will Wingsy get in the way of the eruption?

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.126: The Seven Foods / The Perfect Portrait
programme.desc: The Barbababies think their food can make them change colours and shapes. They decide to find the right food for each of them. // Barbabeau lacks inspiration, he can't create anymore. The whole family helps by suggesting new subjects to paint.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.201: Moving Mission / Barbabright's Invention
programme.desc: During a walk, the Barbapapa family discovers a megalith. // Barbabright has a stroke of genius: the invention of the "BAM".

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.202: Princess For A Day / Barbabeau's Adventure
programme.desc: Barbabelle proudly announces to her family that she wants to become a princess. // Barbabravo is moping with boredom, his brothers and sisters are all busy and no one wants to play with him.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.104: The Crew Builds A Playground / The Crew Fixes A Roof
programme.desc: After Speed Meister builds an unsafe playground, the Rubble & Crew get creative and build a whole new one with old materials. // The town Chili Cookaroo is threatened when City Hall's roof starts to cave in! Luckily, the pups know just how to fix it.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.105: The Crew Builds A Car Wash / The Crew Plans Grandpa Day
programme.desc: Mayor Greatway needs her muddy motorcycle cleaned fast! Wheeler and the pups jump into action to build a solution before the big race. // It's Grandpa Gravel's special day! But when the pups are needed, they have to change their Grandpa Day plans.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.316: Pups Bear-ly Save Danny / Pups Save the Mayor's Tulips
programme.desc: Daring Danny X is at it again! This time he’s stuck in a tree over a deep canyon and is pursued by hungry bears. // Mayor Humdinger sabotages Mayor Goodway’s perfect petals for the tulip contest. Chase and Rocky to the rescue!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.317: All Star Pups! / Pups Save Sports Day
programme.desc: It’s monkey mayhem as pups play kickball against Raimondo’s team, until an eagle steals the ball. // The All Star Pups are ready to compete in the summer sports day when Daring Danny X turns the field into an ice rink!

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.416: Cave Invaders / Stone Pangolin Surprise
programme.desc: When Jade is at a party Baron Bite raids the Crystal Caves and causes crystal carnage! // Rammy discovers an ancient Kung Fu move that transforms him into a giant stone pangolin.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1 Ep.104: The Frog Prince / The King's Busy Day
programme.desc: Holly turns Ben into a frog. She tries to turn Ben back into an elf. Nanny Plum comes to the rescue. // Holly and King Thistle spend the day launching a boat, judging a fruit competition and making a speech at the Festival of Elf and Fairy Dancing.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.108: Double Booked / Bogweed / Prizes
programme.desc: Tim tries to be at two parties at once. // Tim tries to find a bogweed free snack for Kai. // After losing again and again, Tia tries to win every party game.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.309: The Crew Builds An Art Museum / The Crew Builds A Giant Alphorn
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build the perfect place to show off River's ever-changing photography projects... Builder Cove's own art museum! // Farmer Zoe has a new goat on her farm! But when she can't find the singing goat, the pups team up with Park Ranger Rose.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.107: The Treasure of El Bravo
programme.desc: After Enrique steals the heart of El Bravo, there's only one person who can help Santi and crew save the day: Tomás's younger sister, Prima Tina!

programme.title: DORA S2 Ep.204: The Floor Is Guava / We Are The Grumples
programme.desc: Boots wants to enjoy Banana Fest, but the Guava Geyser is erupting! Dora needs to stop the geyser and save the festival. / It's Picture Day, but the Grumpy Old Troll runs away! Dora follows him into Troll World to get him to come out for the picture.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S2 Ep.217: Race Car Superstar
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ visit VelocityVille, a town full of race cars where everybody loves to go fast! When a snooty car named Speedrick traps all the other racers, Blaze must transform into a super-fast race car to free his new friends.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.113: Stuck On You / Pest Friend
programme.desc: Daisy worries she and Winston will be stuck together forever when they get tangled in Winston's jump rope. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile try to help Roland find a best friend to take to an acorn show.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.103: Boris / Born To Be Wild
programme.desc: The barbababies find a lost baby elephant and secretly look after it. How will Barbapapa and Barbamama react to Boris? // Boris the elephant misses home. The Barbapapa decide to bring him back to Africa. On the spot, they help Boris to acclimatize.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.104: Making Bread / From One Pit to Another
programme.desc: Barbapapa wants to teach his children to make bread, but things don't go as planned... // The Barbababies plant an avocado tree. However, it takes years before the first harvest. Barbabright has an idea to save time that may well lead to...disaster.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.203: Beach Scanner / Tidy / Pets
programme.desc: Tim and Kai try to uncover trinkets buried at the beach. // Tim has a clearout of all his old stuff, but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish bin. // Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S6 Ep.616: Special Mission Blaze
programme.desc: When a nefarious villain steals every toothbrush in Axle City, Blaze's only chance at saving the day is to become: Special Mission Blaze!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S6 Ep.607: The Construction Contest
programme.desc: To compete in the Axle City Construction Contest, Blaze and his friends turn into construction vehicles! But when Crusher sends them far away, it'll take all of their construction skills combined to make it back before time runs out.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.222: The Crew Builds A Hotel / The Crew Builds A Hiking Trail
programme.desc: Builder Cove gets its first hotel when Farmer Zoe's cousin Hadley comes to visit. But will Hadley approve of the new hotel?// After a hiking trail mix-up confuses everyone going to Mr. Ducky-Doo's birthday party, the pups help them get back on track.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.223: The Crew Builds A Kangaroo Safari / The Crew Plays In The Construction Games
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build a kangaroo safari for Lucas and Lily right in the Bark Yard... until their construction kangaroo hops away! // Speed Meister challenges Rubble & Crew to compete in the ultimate build-off: Builder Cove's first Construction Games!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S8 Ep.823: Pups Save the Floating Goodways / Pups Save the Portable Pet Wash
programme.desc: The Goodways drift out to sea on a swan shaped float and need rescued from a flock of real swans aiming to protect the giant inflatable. // Mayor Humdinger steals Katie's Portable Pet Wash and ends up causing bubble trouble all over town.

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.417: Rocks To The Rescue / Sock Shock
programme.desc: Bobbi befriends some space rock aliens. They love playing with Bobbi and refuse to let him go. // Professor Scratch invents a tracker to locate all of Sir Steel's missing socks which come to life!

programme.title: DORA S2 Ep.211: The Great Abuela Cookoff / Missing Map
programme.desc: After the Pokey Pigeons eat all of Abuela's elotes, Dora and Boots set out to find more ingredients for the Great Abuela Cook-off. / Dora, Boots and Backpack play an adventurous game of Hide-and-Seek to find Map.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.110: The Enchanted Melody / Chicken Abuelo
programme.desc: When Escarlata gets ahold of an enchanted guitar riff, all of the underseas may soon fall under her spell. // Tomás accidentally turns Abuelo into a chicken!

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.208: Walky Talky / Brothers / Blob Monster
programme.desc: Tim tries to return a lost walky talky to it's owner. // Tim and Tommy go on a camping trip, but soon disagree on what to do first. // When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.105: Nebulator
programme.desc: Kai is super excited to ride the Nebulator, but Tim isn't so sure.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1 Ep.105: Fun and Games / King Thistle is Not Well
programme.desc: Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win games. Then Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic to win the games. // King Thistle needs medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly and Ben collect the ingredients for a potion to make him better.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.116: Hiccupism / Silence please
programme.desc: Barbabeau can't paint. He has a hiccup he can't get rid of. Just when he's about to give up, he accidentally creates a new artistic movement. // Barbalib wants to compete in a writing contest but his brothers and sisters stop her from concentrating.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.117: Where Did It Go Barbabravo? / The Big Bad Hen
programme.desc: Like a secret agent, Barbabravo leads the investigation equipped with his gadgets to find out who stole Barbapapa's cake. // Barbalala is convinced she heard a giant hen prowling around the house. The Barbababies organize themselves to stand guard.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.102: Birthday Party / Tick Tock Mr. Croc
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile wants to be a good guest at Daisy's birthday party since he's never been to one before. // Rushing to get to a concert on time, Mr. Crocodile and Daisy misplace their tickets at Mom's Box and Ship Shop.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S9 Ep.905: The Great Bedtime Race
programme.desc: It's nighttime in Axle City, and Blaze and AJ stumble upon the race of their dreams: the Great Bedtime Race! But Crusher is also in the race and he won't rest until he wins. Will Blaze come out on top, or will Crusher take home the Nightlight Trophy?

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S9 Ep.906: Ice Cream Team
programme.desc: Ice Cream Truck Blaze must help out in three ice cream emergencies by transforming into three epic ice cream vehicles: an Ice Cream Helicopter, an Ice Cream Submarine, and an Ice Cream Spaceship!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.118: The Crew Builds A Library Tea Shop / The Crew Builds A Dance Floor
programme.desc: Construction on the first Builder Cove library is abuzz with bees! This calls for an extra sweet constuction solution. / Grandpa Gravel teaches Charger all his best moves for the big dance contest. But will a runaway disco ball cost them first place?

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.119: The Crew Builds A Giant Lemonade Stand / The Crew Builds A Wildlife Bridge
programme.desc: After the Crew builds a special lemonade stand for Lucas and Lily, a sour Speed Meister sends it rolling through Builder Cove! // Why does Crunchy the beaver cross the road? Because Rubble & Crew build a bridge to help him get to the other side!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S4 Ep.425: Pups Save Baby Humdinger / Pups Save a Pinata
programme.desc: Tracker has a dream that Mayor Humginder turns into a baby! Now it's up to the pups to find the special coconuut to reverse the spell. // Alex is hosting a fun party in Adventure Bay but is heartbroken when his special pinata mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S5 Ep.501: Pups Save the Kitty Rescue Crew / Pups Save an Ostrich
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger makes fake emergencies for his kitties to save so they appear better then the PAW Patrol. // The Wingnuts get a new pet ostrich, but it gets lost on the trip home. The PAW Patrol must find and lead it to the Wingnuts' ranch.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.219: Rebels / Barbascience
programme.desc: Barbidur and Barbalala become little rebels. // But who are the Barbapapa?

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.220: The Barbababies Have Got Talent / Triple Switcheroo
programme.desc: Every barbababy is invited to show their greatest talent on stage. // Video games are fun, but you also need to know how to enjoy the nice weather!

programme.title: Bedtime Stories with Ryan S1 Ep.105: Goodnight &, Hello, Words
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan tells stories full of chatter.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.102: The Riddle of Raging Rhinos / The Trouble in the Tundra
programme.desc: What's causing the friendly rhinos to rage out at the Watering Hole hangout? // Sam and Kit are on the case when the Mice Squad goes missing in the Arctic.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.103: The Puzzle of the Plummeting Eggs / The Missing Mole Rat Princess
programme.desc: Sam and Kit look for a mysterious bird who's messing with everyone's nests. // The duo tracks down a royal mole rat who left her underground palace.

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.417: Rocks To The Rescue / Sock Shock
programme.desc: Bobbi befriends some space rock aliens. They love playing with Bobbi and refuse to let him go. // Professor Scratch invents a tracker to locate all of Sir Steel's missing socks which come to life!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.142: Daddy Gets Fit
programme.desc: Peppa instructs Daddy Pig to do lots of exercise to do as he is a bit fat. Daddy Pig is horrified to learn you have to exercise every day to get fit.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.143: Tidying Up
programme.desc: Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy. The room doesn't stay tidy for long though.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.144: The Playground
programme.desc: Peppa and George go to the playground. Peppa's friends are also there. Peppa likes going on the swings but George does not because he's scared of heights, so Daddy Pig helps George go down the slide because it is too high and ends up getting stuck.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.145: Daddy Puts Up a Picture
programme.desc: Daddy Pig offers to put up a picture of Peppa and George on the wall while Mummy Pig is out. He accidentally cracks the wall while doing it, so Peppa and George help Daddy Pig fix the wall before Mummy Pig comes home.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1 Ep.103: Daisy and Poppy / Queen Thistle's Teapot
programme.desc: Holly's little sisters, Daisy and Poppy, borrow a wand, escape from the castle and turn the whole kingdom into bunny rabbits and frogs. // Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot. Holly accidentally breaks it and tries to fix it with Ben's help.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S9 Ep.926: Charger Visits the Pups / Pups Save a Shiny Ride
programme.desc: Rubble's cousin, Charger, visits Adventure Bay just in time to help out when a Humdinger-caused geyser destroys Mr. Porter's cafe. // Mayor Humdinger hatches a plan to sabotage a "Shinest Ride Contest", so it's up to the Paw Patrol to save the day.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S11 Ep.1116: Pups Save the Chicken Conductor
programme.desc: Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Ed out the window.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.309: The Crew Builds An Art Museum / The Crew Builds A Giant Alphorn
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build the perfect place to show off River's ever-changing photography projects... Builder Cove's own art museum! // Farmer Zoe has a new goat on her farm! But when she can't find the singing goat, the pups team up with Park Ranger Rose.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.123: The Crew Builds a Fountain Show
programme.desc: When Sierra Sparkle's big concert stage needs some extra sparkle, Rubble & Crew use a construction complication to make a big splash.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.104: Tooth On The Loose / Scaredy Croc
programme.desc: When Mr. Crocodile loses a tooth, Daisy wants to make sure he gets a visit from the tooth fairy. // Mr. Crocodile, Daisy and their friends are scared to fetch Martin's gloves from his spooky shed.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.220: The Barbababies Have Got Talent / Triple Switcheroo
programme.desc: Every barbababy is invited to show their greatest talent on stage. // Video games are fun, but you also need to know how to enjoy the nice weather!

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.108: Marvelous Moustaches
programme.desc: Barbazoo collects photos of moustached celebrities. Unfortunately, it's impossible to find the last one: Charles Horseshoe-Furlip. He suspects a conspiracy...

programme.title: DORA S3 Ep.307: Learning To Fly / Queen Swiper
programme.desc: Dora and Boots help Dulce the Dragon learn to fly so she can reach her parents at Cloudy Caves. // After La Reina and Swiper's bodies were switched by Big Red Chicken's magic, Dora and Boots help them switch back!

programme.title: DORA S4 Ep.404: Mr. Banana's Big Puppet Show
programme.desc: Dora rescues Boots' special banana puppet before the Golden Monkeys can get to it!

programme.title: La Belle Vie Ep.6: Life as the wind blows
programme.desc: Julien meets Joanie and Hugues, two former members of the armed forces, just a few days be-fore they set sail for the southern seas. Aboard their catamaran, they plan to spend five years seeking out the finest kitesurfing spots around the globe.

programme.title: Chroniques Méditerranéennes Nature Ep.5: The Estérel, Inland
programme.desc: The volcanic Estérel Massif stretches from Provence to the Mediterranean. A true kaleidoscope of colours, it is neither a nature reserve nor a park, yet it remains protected thanks to the commitment of its inhabitants.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus Ep.31: Rocket Rocky
programme.desc: Four little dinosaurs, Rocky, Bill, Tiny and Mazu, discover a dangerous world where the mysterious Gigantosaurus, the most ferocious of all the dinosaurs, is forever on the prowl. The four best friends set their heading for adventure, confronting their fears and working together to solve all their problems.

programme.title: L'Afrik En Contes Ep.23: Mouloukou the gorilla
programme.desc: Mouloukou the gorilla is king of the forest. He forbids any of his subjects to drink from the river before him. But one day, a lion cub dares to break the rule.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi Ep.9: The generous genii
programme.desc: Olive, Pétole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: Rocky & Lily : C'Est Dans La Boîte ! Ep.11: We're making noise!
programme.desc: Every day, Rocky and Lily receive a new box on the set. But what does it contain? It's always a surprising object that leads them to discover very different subjects: turtles, bowling or even cloud formation.

programme.title: Drazilion Ep.10: The Cruel Minor
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: Le Point
programme.desc: Magazine programme which explores issues relating to society, science and the environment, involving investigations and in-depth analysis, from a resolutely Canadian perspective.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Tout Ce Qu'Il Me Reste De La Révolution
programme.desc: Angèle, a young qualified town planner, campaigns as much as she can against capitalist society, between happenings and expression groups. Born into a family of militants, she confronts their disengagement: a nostalgic father, an ultra-liberalsister and a mother who has retired to the countryside. Meeting Saïd shaes up her deeply held beliefs.

programme.title: La Grande Arche
programme.desc: When the austere district of La Défense, a symbol of modernity, becomes the setting for a reflection on architecture, memory, and power.

programme.title: Anushan
programme.desc: The only son of Tamil parents, 13-year-old Anushan much prefers rap to his native culture. When his uncle arrives from Sri Lanka, he finds himself sharing his room and his daily life with him for a few days.

programme.title: Opj Ep.11: Death in Reserve (1)
programme.desc: The body of Hélène Bertillon, director of a water sports base, is found in the Saint-Paul pond nature reserve. As the investigation is conducted jointly by the police and the gendarmerie, tensions rise quickly.

programme.title: Opj Ep.12: Death in Reserve (2)
programme.desc: Another body is discovered and all eyes turn to the victim's phone, which may contain valuable clues.
